name: Hosting - Publish Helm chart to static.colanode.com

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
      S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
      S3_ENDPOINT: ${{ secrets.S3_ENDPOINT }}
      S3_BUCKET: ${{ secrets.S3_BUCKET }}
      S3_REGION: ${{ secrets.S3_REGION }}
      CHART_DIR: hosting/kubernetes/chart

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Extract version from tag
        run: echo "VERSION=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/v}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - uses: azure/setup-helm@v3
        with: { version: v3.14.3 }

      - run: helm dependency update "$CHART_DIR"

      - name: Update Chart.yaml appVersion
        run: |
          sed -i "s/^appVersion:.*/appVersion: '${{ env.VERSION }}'/" "$CHART_DIR/Chart.yaml"

      - name: Configure AWS CLI
        run: aws configure set default.s3.addressing_style path

      - name: Package chart
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          helm package "$CHART_DIR" --destination dist

      - name: Fetch existing index.yaml
        run: |
          aws s3 cp s3://${{ secrets.S3_BUCKET }}/hosting/kubernetes/chart/index.yaml dist/index.yaml \
            --endpoint-url "$S3_ENDPOINT" --region "$S3_REGION" --checksum-algorithm CRC32 || true

      - name: Re-index repo
        working-directory: dist
        run: |
          helm repo index . \
            --url "https://static.colanode.com/hosting/kubernetes/chart" \
            $(test -f index.yaml && echo "--merge index.yaml")

      - name: Upload chart and index to S3
        env:
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          AWS_S3_ADDRESSING_STYLE: path
        run: |
          aws s3 cp dist/ s3://${{ secrets.S3_BUCKET }}/hosting/kubernetes/chart/ \
            --recursive \
            --endpoint-url "$S3_ENDPOINT" \
            --region "$S3_REGION" \
            --checksum-algorithm CRC32

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
